assumptions.choice: Implement the 2% stop-loss as a native stop order (exectype=bt.Order.Stop) submitted via self.close() immediately upon entry fill, priced at entry_price*(1-0.02) for longs or entry_price*(1+0.02) for shorts.
assumptions.reason: A stop-loss is a price-triggered exit; a real Stop order faithfully replicates intrabar triggering, and self.close() sizes the exit to exactly flatten the current position rather than using the default sizer stake.

assumptions.choice: While a position (with its pending stop order) is open, new MACD-histogram zero crossovers are ignored; only after the stop-loss closes the position can a new entry be taken.
assumptions.reason: Canonical default: hold at most one position at a time, no pyramiding/reversal; the spec states no exit rule other than the stop-loss, so no signal-based reversal exit is added.

assumptions.choice: Entries use self.buy()/self.sell() with no size argument (default sizer).
assumptions.reason: Spec is silent on position sizing; canonical default applies.

assumptions.choice: The stop-loss is the only exit mechanism; there is no take-profit, opposite-crossover exit, or time-based exit.
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly states 'No additional filters or exit rules are used.'
